topic: Auto-expiry alerts for work permits and visas — how the dashboard surfaces renewals 30/60/90 days out
format: Open with the specific operational problem, then show how one SmartPRO Hub feature addresses it end-to-end
post:
One expired work permit slipped through last March at a logistics firm in Muscat.

The employee couldn't board a flight. The client meeting fell apart. Two days of scrambling, one very uncomfortable conversation with a GM.

Nobody had flagged the expiry. It was buried in a spreadsheet no one checked.

This is exactly the problem SmartPRO Hub's permit tracking dashboard was built to solve.

Every work permit and visa in the system gets a 30, 60, and 90-day renewal alert — automatically. HR managers see a prioritized renewals queue the moment they log in. No digging. No missed dates.

Our customers tell us the 90-day window is the one that changed their workflow. It gives PRO teams enough runway to prepare documents, coordinate with government portals, and avoid rush fees.

One alert. Three lead times. Zero surprises on travel day.

For HR managers juggling 50+ permits across nationalities and visa types, this isn't a nice-to-have. It's the difference between a smooth renewal and an operational incident.

Work permit tracking GCC teams actually rely on — that's what SmartPRO Hub delivers starting at OMR 12/month, no credit card required.
